history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. It's completely dead as far as the network goes.

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s service issue. First, I’ll need to identify your account to check for any line or account-related problems.

Could you please provide one of the following:
- Your phone number
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
Sure, my phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line status is currently Active, so there are no suspensions or contract issues on your account.

Let’s proceed with troubleshooting your phone’s service. To start, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- SIM card error or missing SIM icon
- Any signal bars at all (even if they are empty or crossed out)

This will help determine if the issue is with your device settings or the network. If you’re unsure how to check, let me know and I can guide you through it.
I see the airplane mode icon is on, and it says 'No Signal' in the status bar. Data is enabled, but there are no signal bars at all.

The Airplane mode being ON is the reason you have no service—this mode disables all wireless connections, including cellular service. To restore your network connection, please turn Airplane mode OFF.

Once you’ve done that, check if your signal bars return and if you can send picture messages. If you still have issues after turning off Airplane mode, let me know and we’ll continue troubleshooting.
Airplane mode is now OFF. I see signal bars and 5G in the corner. Would you like me to try sending a picture message or run a speed test to confirm it's working?

That’s great news! Now that you have signal bars and 5G service, please try sending a picture message to confirm that MMS is working. You can also run a speed test if you’d like to check your data connection quality.

If both work as expected, your service should be fully restored. If you encounter any issues with sending picture messages or notice slow data speeds, let me know and I’ll help you troubleshoot further.
The speed test result came back excellent on 5G, and my connection quality is excellent. I was also able to send a picture message with no issues. Everything looks good now!

That’s excellent to hear! Your service and data connection are fully restored, and MMS is working as expected.

If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
